3D Graphics & Animation Intern — Tridum VISTA 360 LLC (Remote)
We are looking for a creative and enthusiastic 3D Graphics & Animation Intern for a 6-month internship, ideal for candidates passionate about 3D design, animation, visual storytelling, and creating engaging digital content.
Key Responsibilities
- Create 3D models, graphics, animations, and visual assets.
- Assist in developing 3D scenes, environments, characters, and product visuals.
- Work on texturing, lighting, rendering, and basic animation.
- Support the team in creating visual content for projects and presentations.
- Collaborate with designers, developers, and other team members.
- Maintain organized project files and follow established workflows.
Required Skills
- Knowledge of 3D modeling and animation.
- Familiarity with software such as Blender, Autodesk Maya, 3ds Max, Cinema 4D, or similar tools.
- Understanding of basic texturing, lighting, rendering, and animation concepts.
- Good visual and creative sense.
- Good communication and teamwork skills.
Eligibility
- Students, fresh graduates, or candidates pursuing courses in 3D Animation, Graphic Design, VFX, Multimedia, Game Design, Architecture, or related fields.
- A portfolio or sample work is preferred.
